clips.title: The story
paras: Vorn Skyseer is a peaceful tauren resident of Camp Narache atop Red Cloud Mesa in Mulgore. Resting among the camp's tents, he greets young adventurers beginning their journeys and introduces them to local life.

Situated in Camp Narache on Red Cloud Mesa, Vorn Skyseer serves as an informal welcoming presence for young tauren. As they undertake their rites of passage before venturing into the wider valleys of Mulgore, Vorn offers kind words and hospitality, helping new arrivals settle into the camp.
Vorn is no warrior. He leaves the camp's defense to its braves and keeps to a quiet, unhurried life, content to watch over the tranquil plains of his homeland.
